items.rule: Keep each Unreleased item on one line, English and at most 200 code points; details belong in commit/PR.
Derive expected suites from Git/Jest; require zero skipped tests and actual status-summary-browser and mirror-browser PASS.
Distinguish malformed regex from zero matches using localized inline feedback and input ARIA associations in all four Body/Raw panes.
Preserve inspector-led layout, grid density, keyboard behavior, safe rendering and existing permissions; do not adopt open design drafts wholesale.
Reveal Body/Raw search only on Ctrl/Cmd+F; preserve copy/view actions, two-stage Escape, close focus restoration, and reset on request selection.
Retain dense keyboard-accessible inspector tabs and compact count badges with theme contrast; author evidence is synthetic and version-scoped.
